culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Noboru Kawakami. Takai abused Sumiyo Hiraya as a subordinate employee and this drove her to suicide. Conan reveals the truth by showing how the room was switched around. When Conan and Heiji leave, concur that Jodie is someone suspicious, but believe that she is innocuous. The ending scene shows that she's already on to them in that Jodie's already knows Heiji's name and has pictures of Kudo during the time he regressed back to his former self.

motive.quote: The cursive "cool guy" on Conan's photo was accidentally written in the anime as "cool gay", probably because the animators were not used to English cursive (it's fixed in the remastered version of the episode).

method.quote: Conan reveals the truth by showing how the room was switched around.

evidence.quote: Another evidence showing that Jodie was investigating Doctor Araide was also altered in the anime adaptation.

method.zhHans: 柯南通过展示房间是如何被调换的，揭开了真相。柯南照片上手写的「cool guy」在动画里被误写成了「cool gay」，多半是作画人员不熟悉英文连笔所致（该集的修复版中已改正）。
method.en: Conan reveals the truth by showing how the room was switched around. The cursive "cool guy" on Conan's photo was accidentally written in the anime as "cool gay", probably because the animators were not used to English cursive (it's fixed in the remastered version of the episode).

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Noboru Kawakami。Takai 以上司身份虐待平谷澄江，逼得她自杀。柯南通过展示房间是如何被调换的，揭开了真相。柯南与平次离开时一致认为 Jodie 很可疑，但相信她并无恶意。结尾一幕显示她其实已经盯上了他们——Jodie 早已知道平次的名字，而且手上有工藤变回原样那段时间的照片。
resolution.en: The culprit is Noboru Kawakami. Takai abused Sumiyo Hiraya as a subordinate employee and this drove her to suicide. Conan reveals the truth by showing how the room was switched around. When Conan and Heiji leave, concur that Jodie is someone suspicious, but believe that she is innocuous. The ending scene shows that she's already on to them in that Jodie's already knows Heiji's name and has pictures of Kudo during the time he regressed back to his former self.

l3Absent.reason: 原文只有 Takai 虐待下属致其自杀的背景，未给出凶手动机
